rationales: Necrosis is the accidental, uncontrolled death of cells.
Apoptosis is programmed cell death, not accidental cell death.
Blebs are bulges of the cell membrane and are not a type of cell death.
Metastasis is the spread of cancer cells to other parts of the body.
Substrates are the molecules on which enzymes act.
Products are formed by an enzyme-catalyzed reaction.
Co-factors assist some enzymes but are not the molecules on which they act.
Coenzymes are organic helpers for enzymes, not their target molecules.
Ribose does not have three carbon atoms.
Ribose does not have four carbon atoms.
Ribose is a five-carbon sugar.
Ribose does not have six carbon atoms.
The stomach does not have villi.
The oesophagus does not have villi.
Villi are found in the small intestine, where they increase the surface area for absorption.
The large intestine does not have the absorptive villi found in the small intestine.
Platelets help blood clot.
Erythrocytes mainly transport oxygen and do not cause blood clotting.
Neutrophils are white blood cells that help defend against infection.
Basophils are white blood cells involved in inflammatory and allergic responses.
Taxonomy is the science of naming and classifying organisms.
Physiology studies how organisms and their parts function.
Entomology is the study of insects.
Biotechnology uses organisms or biological processes for practical purposes.
Glucose is a small molecule and is an example of a micromolecule.
Starch is a large polysaccharide molecule.
Proteins are generally large biological molecules.
Lipids are generally grouped among large biological molecules in this classification.
Ronald Ross later demonstrated the role of mosquitoes in malaria transmission.
A. F. A. King proposed an association between mosquitoes and malaria, but did not begin the 1878 work described.
Laveran, a French Army physician, began investigating malaria in 1878 and discovered its parasite.
Mendel is known for his work on heredity, not malaria.
An order contains related families, rather than being the group of nearest genera.
A phylum is a much broader taxonomic group.
A class contains related orders and is broader than a family.
A family is a group of closely related genera.
Protein is not the characteristic structural material of fungal cell walls.
Chitin is a principal structural component of fungal cell walls.
Fat is not the structural material of fungal cell walls.
Cellulose is characteristic of plant cell walls, not fungal cell walls.
Stroma is the fluid-filled region of a chloroplast, not a stack of thylakoids.
Cristae are folds of the inner mitochondrial membrane.
A granum is a stack of thylakoids in a chloroplast.
A chloroplast is the whole organelle, not a stack of thylakoids.
Mitosis produces two daughter cells from one cell.
Four daughter cells are typically produced by meiosis, not mitosis.
Mitosis does not produce six daughter cells.
Mitosis does not produce eight daughter cells.
Meiosis produces gametes and is not the usual process associated with tumor formation.
Errors or loss of control in mitosis can cause abnormal cell proliferation and tumors.
Binary fission is a form of cell division in prokaryotes.
Multiple fission is not the process described as causing tumors.
Amylase acts on starch and other carbohydrates.
Pepsin digests proteins.
Lipase breaks down lipids.
Proteases break down proteins.
Reduction is the gain of electrons.
Hydration is the addition of water.
Oxidation is the loss of electrons.
Electrolysis is a process using electric current to drive a chemical reaction.
